english.title: Fail to ensure lame animal not dragged to place of killing at premises other than slaughterhouse
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the business operator]_
(B)_[a person engaged in the movement or lairaging of animals]_

in respect of premises, other than a slaughterhouse, used for the killing of animals, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed to ensure that an animal which was unable to walk was not dragged to its place of killing but was killed where it lay or, if it was possible and to do so would not cause any unnecessary pain or suffering, was transported on a trolley or movable platform to a place of emergency killing where it was then immediately killed
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(d) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 14 of Schedule 2 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
